title: Project Metadata
description: Schema for /.project.json consumed by alexcatdad.github.io snapshot generation.

what.description: Short statement of what the project is.

why.description: Short statement of why the project exists.

hero.description: Hero image URL or repo-relative path (for example: assets/hero.png).

tags.description: Optional display tags for project cards.

featured.description: Featured projects sort before non-featured projects.

order.description: Lower numbers sort earlier among equally featured projects.

examples.what: Zero-config HTTPS proxy for local macOS development.
examples.why: Built to remove HTTPS friction from OAuth and secure-cookie local workflows.
